scope: 12 calls to actual reputation helpers using synthetic in-memory records. No localStorage, browser character data, saved character or source mutation. No social/faction/cosmology rule is chosen.

probes.description: Normalization omits an unrecognized campaign faction key
Normalization clamps source Loop endpoint scores to the runtime range
Normalization replaces a malformed score with neutral
Background reapplication overwrites later standing and drops unknown keys
Setter admits unknown key for one return value
The same setter result loses that key on later normalization
Adjuster also admits an unknown key which later normalization drops
Absent and explicit zero retain different normalized map shapes
Compact entries omit an explicit neutral score
Qualitative label roundtrip loses the distinct value +3
Unknown background keeps known normalized standing but drops unknown faction keys
